thread:
maya: Dropping two quick variants for the billing dashboard: 'dense ledger' (rows) vs 'discovery grid' (cards). Figma: https://figma.com/file/billing-views — thoughts, especially around how users find invoice downloads and token breakdowns?

jared: Dense ledger is excellent for power users who comb through line-items. Discovery grid is friendlier for onboarding and product reviews.

maya: Core decision: do we prioritize immediate access to invoice download per-row/card, or keep a single consolidated download?

tina: My vote: show a small quick-download icon inline for the most-recent invoice and keep a global "Download selected" in the header for bulk. That balances discoverability and density.

infra-bot: Backend note: generating on-demand full CSVs for bulk >100 workspaces can be heavy; recommend async job + email link for large exports.

a11y-bot: Accessibility reminders: 1) if using grid, implement roving tabindex and ARIA grid roles; 2) ensure download buttons have aria-labels like "Download invoice for <workspace> as CSV"; 3) 44px minimum touch targets.

jared: Copy nit: change tooltip text from "Download" to "Download latest invoice (CSV)" so users know format.

maya: Good. Also prototyping tiny token-breakdown pills inline: show percentages, hover/expand for absolute token counts. But hover-only is not acceptable on mobile.

tina: Make the pill tappable to open a small popover with the last-30d token numbers and a link to usage detail. Popover must be dismissible with Esc and have focus trap.

a11y-bot: Popovers must restore focus to the trigger and be reachable by keyboard. Also color contrast flagged on the current accent — use darker shade.

jared: Performance: rendering SVG sparklines for each row in ledger view caused jank at 250 rows in staging. Suggest pre-rendering thumbnails or drawing on an offscreen canvas.

maya: We'll ship ledger with optional sparklines disabled by default, and the grid will show lightweight rasterized mini-charts. Add a user toggle for "Show sparklines" in preferences.

tina: UX for scope switch: switching Org <-> Project currently collapses header and causes content jump. Proposal: fixed-height toolbar with scope toggle and search so the content below doesn't shift.

a11y-bot: Announce scope changes to SRs: use aria-live polite region when scope changes finish loading.

maya: Action items: 1) I'll update Figma with inline quick-download + bulk select pattern; 2) add tappable token pill + popover copy; 3) create a note for infra about async export for >100 items.

jared: I'll prototype the ledger perf change (offscreen canvas) and estimate impact.

tina: I'll write the copy for aria-labels/tooltips and put them in Figma comments.

maya: Thanks — targeting design crit on Thursday. :sparkles:
